facts.fact: 小妹 Rachel 抱着 Eden 的腿不撒手，哥哥 Jake（比她小却 6'5"）把她拎开。
facts.anchor: Jake scoops her up into his arms, letting the blood flow back into my legs

facts.fact: Eden 是五个孩子里的老大，也是唯一离巢进城读书的。
facts.anchor: Being the eldest of five kids—and the only one who has flown the nest

facts.fact: Eden 第一年修 Contemporary Literature 挂科，这是她这学期重修的原因。
facts.anchor: Ending that subject with a failure was not my happiest moment

facts.fact: 再挂就丢 post-grad 名额，丢了 post-grad 就丢 PhD offer——Eden 把这年当成生死线。
facts.anchor: And if I lose my PhD offer, I basically don’t have a reason to live

facts.fact: 临别时 Jake 对 Eden 说全家都以她为骄傲。
facts.anchor: You know we’re all proud of you, right?

facts.fact: Gemma 接站，两人又一次分到同一层宿舍。
facts.anchor: On the same floor, as always.

facts.fact: Gemma 的姐姐 Misty 来读教职后留下，当上学生宿舍主管。
facts.anchor: taking over as head of student accommodation

facts.fact: Gemma 罗列家教名单（Cory Donovan、Heath Carson、Jamil Sutherland、Oliver James），Eden 答应后 Gemma 抢回手机替她发了咨询。
facts.anchor: she snatches her phone back and sends an inquiry in my name
